text:
Maya: FYI vendor just messaged: partial shipment delay for 8 H100s intended for APAC dedicated pools. ETA now Mon 03:00 UTC. Can we confirm impact?
Liam: which racks/allocations? any serials?
Maya: vendor giving rack IDs in the email, attaching snippet: rack-APAC-07 (partial), rack-APAC-09 delayed. No serials yet.
Samir: ok that's the burst pool we planned to use for the demo on Tue. We should try to swap to standby slots in AU or borrow from EU if latency ok.
Iris: pinging oncall: Samir can you open a quick alloc ticket? I'll try to shift terraform labels.
Samir: opened #alloc-9853 — asking for 4 H100s from eu-west. CC @Liam for billing approval.
Liam: finance check: taking from EU will add ~18% bandwidth cost and possible SLA delta. Need approval from @Maya.
Maya: approve for demo; keep costs visible. Can we avoid re-baking images? prefer just alias swap.
Samir: working on small terraform patch, will push in a sec. snippet:
```
resource "redwood_alloc" "temp-borrow" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  gpu_count = 4
  ttl = "36h"
}
```
Iris: can you also add a routing policy tweak to prefer eu fallback for that tenant? small API PR ok.
Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123 — includes allocator + fallback policy. needs 1 review.
Maya: @Liam can you LGT M the billing change? we need it turned on by EOD PST.
Liam: LGTM from finance, just confirm tags for cost center: `demo-apac-fallback`.
Samir: tags added.
deploy-bot: Canary allocation applied to tenant-demo (4 GPUs eu-west1) — roll started.
Iris: verified routing tweak in staging, latency bump is +22ms 95p to APAC users, acceptable for demo.
Maya: ok thanks all. Follow-up: vendor asked if we want them to expedite partial shipment for extra fee. let's discuss during standup; I'll note action item.
Samir: leaving a quick note to run update smoke tomorrow 07:00 UTC.
Maya: thanks :thumbsup:
